content.title: Bond Price‐Level Mispricing: A Multifactor Identity
content.abstract: This paper develops a new estimator of abnormal bond prices, defined as the deviation of market prices from the present value of future coupon payments and accrued interest under a multifactor stochastic discount factor (SDF). Existing price‐level approaches rely on restrictive assumptions and single‐factor SDFs that are poorly suited to fixed‐income markets. We propose an identity‐based estimator grounded in the Fama and French five‐factor bond model (FFBM). It mirrors traditional abnormal return tests while avoiding overlapping return windows and reducing sensitivity to SDF measurement error
